posts.title: Drawing Boxes vs. Shading Them In
posts.description: There are two primary kinds of human endeavor: drawing boxes and shading them in. The first defines the boundaries of behavior, culture, and discussion; it draws the boxes. The latter implements those definitions and works within those boundaries. In other words, it shades them in. I think these two definitions can help us grapple with a lot of the current debate around the role of humans and A.I.
